text:
claire: Quick sync 30s Need final marketplace-ready artifacts for H200/H100, MI300, Gaudi. Two asks: canonical SKU + immutable image hashes, and embargo window for joint PR. Can people chime in?

yu: For SKUs I suggest pattern: redwood-hw_<vendor>_<model>_<profile>_v<major>. Lowercase helps scripts. e.g., redwood-hw_nvidia_h200_standard_v1

andre: Image hashes: vendors gave us sha256 for containers but some still on mutable tags. We should require digest pinned images like `ghcr.io/vendor/h200@sha256:...`. I'll run a quick sweep tonight.

pauline: From comms side  we need a 96h embargo minimum for joint press. Partners pushing 72h but legal wants 96h for cross-region. If we target week of 05/09, embargo window would be 05/05-05/09.

claire: Noted. Can we avoid committing public announce until we have firmware regression sign-off?

yu: Nvidia update: H200 firmware candidate in pre-prod; flagged intermittent NVLINK telemetry under heavy IO. Lab thinks it's a driver/firmware interaction; tentative ship if telemetry patch lands by 05/02.

andre: MI300: AMD quoted microcode rev on 05/06, with ECC regression fix still under test. They said they'd provide signed image by 05/08.

si-bot: Created SI checklist entry SI-4492: "hw-marketplace-hand-off: collect pinned-images, skus, embargo-window" assigned to @andre and @pauline 

pauline: I'll draft embargo calendar and PR cadence doc and post to partnerships + comms. Will also mark external copy freeze until 05/03.

release-coordinator: Please attach kernel/userland compatibility matrix and any kernel-reqs. Marketplace QA will run smoke tests against pinned digests.

claire: Action items: 1) Andre to provide pinned digests + verification script by EOD; 2) Yu to confirm H200 telemetry regression status 05/02; 3) Pauline to publish embargo calendar and freeze; 4) Release-coordinator to schedule QA run after digests available. Hold public pages until sign-off. Thanks. :white_check_mark:
